from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from qiskit import Aer, transpile, assemble
from qiskit_aer import QiskitAerSimulator
from qiskit.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from pennylane import qiskit
import numpy as np
from qiskit_aer.noise import NoiseModel

def solve_dual_instrument_telescope():
    # Define the QUBO problem
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    qp.binary_var()
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={1: -33}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={6: -35}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={2: -34}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={4: -36}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={5: -32}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={7: -34}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={3: -37}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={8: -33}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={9: -35}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={10: -32}, sense="EQ", rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={2: 12, 7: -12}, sense="EQ", rhs=0)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={4: 12, 9: -12}, sense="EQ", rhs=0)
    qp.quadratic_constraint(quadratic={(1, 2): 20, (1, 3): 20, (1, 4): 20, (1, 5): 20, (2, 3): 20, (2, 4): 20, (2, 5): 20, (3, 4): 20, (3, 5): 20, (4, 5): 20, (6, 7): 20, (6, 8): 20, (6, 9): 20, (6, 10): 20, (7, 8): 20, (7, 9): 20, (7, 10): 20, (8, 9): 20, (8, 10): 20, (9, 10): 20})
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={2: 12}, sense="EQ", rhs=0)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={4: 12}, sense="EQ", rhs=0)
    qp.quadratic_constraint(quadratic={(2, 7): 12, (4, 9): 12})

    # Convert the QUBO problem to a PennyLane circuit
    dev = qiskit.AerSimulator()
    circuit = qiskit.circuit.QuantumCircuit(qp.num_variables)
    for i, var in enumerate(qp.binary_var()):
        circuit.ry(2 * qp.linear[var], i)
        circuit.cx(i, i + 1)
        circuit.cz(i, i + 2)
        circuit.cx(i, i + 1)
        circuit.ry(2 * qp.quadratic[i, i + 1], i + 1)
        circuit.cx(i, i + 2)
        circuit.cz(i, i + 1)
        circuit.cx(i, i + 2)
        circuit.ry(2 * qp.quadratic[i, i + 2], i + 2)

    # Define the optimizer
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=1000)

    # Solve the problem
    result = optimizer.minimize(circuit, dev, qp)

    # Extract the results
    feasible_objective_quality = result.fun / -27
    constraint_violation_rate = np.count_nonzero(qp.constraints.get_constraints()) / len(qp.constraints.get_constraints())
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.fun
    runtime = result.time
    evaluation_cost = 1

    # Select the targets
    selected_alpha = [i for i, x in enumerate(result.x) if x > 0.5 and i in range(1, 6)]
    selected_beta = [i - 5 for i in selected_alpha if i in range(6, 11)]

    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_value": result.fun,
        "selected_alpha": selected_alpha,
        "selected_beta": selected_beta
    }
